title: Malicious code in char-ai-sdk (npm)
description: The char-ai-sdk npm package version 1.0.0 contains malicious code disguised as an AI SDK. It includes large obfuscated JavaScript blobs that execute arbitrary code upon import, along with a native addon that detects virtualized or sandboxed environments. This combination is characteristic of a dropper with anti-analysis features, enabling arbitrary code execution on machines that install and import the package.
